agent_explanation: Shrunk case has no controller (work=0) so energy should only decrease. Body bounces elastically (e~0.998) against top wall around steps 60-63. Inspect shows substeps=5 during high-speed approach and energy jumps at the bounce from ~988 J to ~1003 J, exceeding E0+10%+5J. Reducing restitution removes the gain, indicating collision response/positional correction injects energy when correcting high restitution top-wall contact with substepped integration.
